name: KG Mobility Platform Co., Ltd.
summary: KG Mobility Platform Co., Ltd. distributes used vehicles in South Korea. The company sells used cars through online and offline channels with home delivery and facilitates vehicle purchases from individuals through an appraisal and buy-back service. It also provides extended warranty coverage under K Car Warranty, vehicle rental services through K Car Rental, financing and loan products through K Car Finance Services, and vehicle auction services through K Car Auction. Additionally, the company offers a brand certification service that includes vehicle inspection and authentication.
